_meta.description: Standardized Modus Operandi (MO) Knowledge Base for Indian Cyber Crime Investigation & Intake Guidance

patterns.name: Fake Electricity / Utility Bill Disconnection Scam
attack_chain: Victim receives SMS or WhatsApp claiming electricity/utility bill is overdue
Message warns electricity will be disconnected tonight by 9:30 PM
Victim is given an 'electricity officer' mobile number to contact immediately
Scammer instructs victim to pay nominal token fee (₹10 or ₹100) or install remote access APK
Scammer captures credentials or triggers unauthorized debit from victim's account

immediate_actions: Call 1930 Cyber Helpline immediately to freeze fraudulent transaction
Contact your bank's fraud desk to block internet banking and debit cards
Do NOT uninstall any downloaded APK yet — it contains digital evidence
Disconnect your phone from the internet (turn on Airplane mode) if an APK was installed
evidence_to_preserve: Original SMS / WhatsApp message with sender number and timestamp
Bank debit alert SMS and UPI transaction reference (UTR) screenshot
Downloaded APK file or download link history in browser
Call logs showing incoming calls from the scammer

investigation_hints.preliminary_action: Issue immediate Section 91 BNSS freeze request to beneficiary bank/UPI PSP using UTR
notices_required: Section 91 BNSS to Beneficiary Bank for Lien
Section 91 BNSS to Telecom Provider for CDR of suspect mobile
investigation_hints.mule_pattern: Rapid transfer from Layer 1 UPI to Layer 2 P2P mule accounts, then cash withdrawal at ATM within 45-90 minutes

patterns.name: UPI QR Code & Collect Request Scam
attack_chain: Victim posts item for sale on OLX/marketplace or responds to buyer
Scammer poses as interested buyer (often impersonating Army / CISF officer)
Scammer claims unable to pay directly and sends QR code or UPI Collect Request
Scammer misleads victim saying 'Scan this QR code and enter UPI PIN to receive money'
Victim enters PIN; instead of credit, amount is debited from victim's account

immediate_actions: Remember: UPI PIN is ONLY needed to SEND money, NEVER to receive money
Call 1930 immediately with your 12-digit UTR number
De-link or reset your UPI PIN from your banking/UPI application
Report suspect profile on OLX / marketplace platform
evidence_to_preserve: Screenshot of the QR code sent by scammer
Screenshot of UPI Collect request screen and transaction confirmation
Chat conversation on OLX / WhatsApp
Scammer's phone number and UPI VPA handle

investigation_hints.preliminary_action: Identify VPA handle provider and issue urgent lien request via 1930 / I4C CFCFRMS
notices_required: Section 91 BNSS to UPI PSP (NPCI/Bank) for merchant/VPA details
Section 91 BNSS to OLX/Platform for suspect IP & registration data
investigation_hints.mule_pattern: Often uses merchant aggregators or fake QR codes linked to mule accounts in Bharatpe/Paytm merchant handles

patterns.name: Part-Time Task & Online Job Scam
attack_chain: Victim receives unsolicited WhatsApp/Telegram offer for part-time online tasks
Initial tasks (like YouTube videos, write Google reviews) pay small genuine rewards (₹150 - ₹500) to build trust
Victim is added to a VIP Telegram group where fake members post huge profit screenshots
Victim is induced to execute 'Prepaid/Merchant Tasks' by transferring money to receive 30-50% commission
When victim attempts withdrawal, scammer claims system error and demands more deposits for 'taxes' or 'credit score'

immediate_actions: STOP transferring any further money — no 'tax' or 'unlock fee' will recover your funds
Call 1930 immediately with all UTR numbers from your transaction history
Do NOT leave the Telegram group yet — export chat history and capture screenshots first
Contact your bank to place debit lien on recent beneficiary accounts
evidence_to_preserve: Complete Telegram chat export with participant handles and group ID
All bank statements showing individual UTRs, dates, and beneficiary account numbers
Screenshots of the fake task portal showing fictitious balance and withdrawal errors
Payment slip receipts and WhatsApp initial message

investigation_hints.preliminary_action: Correlate multiple UTRs against I4C database; task frauds almost always operate via organized multi-tier mule syndicates
notices_required: Section 91 BNSS to Beneficiary Banks (multiple layers)
Notice to Telegram under IT Act Section 79 for channel and subscriber info
Notice to Domain Registrar for fake task portal suspension
investigation_hints.mule_pattern: Funds dispersed across 10-20 current accounts within 30 minutes, converted to USDT on P2P crypto exchanges

patterns.name: Predatory Loan App & Blackmail / Morphed Photo Harassment
attack_chain: Victim downloads an unverified instant loan app from Play Store or third-party APK link
App mandates permissions for Contacts, Gallery, SMS, and Location before disbursing small amount
Loan app disburses only 50-60% of amount after deducting huge 'processing fee' with 7-day tenure
Even upon repayment, app shows loan active or demands 3x-5x extortionate interest
Recovery agents harvest contacts and send morphed pornographic/shaming photos to victim's family and friends

immediate_actions: Do NOT pay extortion money — paying once leads to repeated higher extortion demands
Revoke app permissions immediately: Settings -> Apps -> Permissions (disable Contacts/Storage)
Inform your family and close contacts that your phone was compromised by a rogue app
Call 1930 or local women/cyber helpline immediately
File complaint under BNS Section 78, 79, and 308
evidence_to_preserve: App name, developer name, APK package file or download URL
Screenshots and audio recordings of threatening calls and WhatsApp messages
UPI payment receipts showing receiver names and VPA addresses
Call records of all harassing recovery numbers

investigation_hints.preliminary_action: Flag app package to CERT-In / Google for takedown; immediately identify primary payment gateway / virtual accounts used for repayments
notices_required: Section 91 BNSS to Payment Aggregators (Razorpay/Cashfree/Paytm) for merchant KYC
Section 91 BNSS to Telecom for CDR/tower location of caller numbers
Emergency takedown request under IT Act 69A
investigation_hints.mule_pattern: Extortion funds routed through aggregator virtual accounts (VAN) into corporate current accounts

patterns.name: Digital Arrest & Law Enforcement Impersonation Scam
attack_chain: Victim receives IVR call claiming a FedEx/courier parcel with passport/MDMA drugs was intercepted
Call is transferred to fake police/CBI officer dressed in uniform over Skype or WhatsApp video call
Scammers show fake arrest warrants with official Government seals and national security warnings
Victim is subjected to 'Digital Arrest' — forced to remain on continuous video call and isolated in a room
Scammer instructs victim to transfer all bank balances to an 'RBI Verification Account' for financial audit

immediate_actions: There is NO provision for 'Digital Arrest' under Indian Law (BNSS/BNS) — police never arrest via video call
Government agencies NEVER ask citizens to transfer money to 'verification accounts'
Disconnect the call immediately and call 1930 / 112
Inform your bank immediately to freeze the outbound RTGS/NEFT transfer
evidence_to_preserve: Skype ID, WhatsApp number, and call screenshots showing the fake police setup
Copies of all fake arrest warrants, official letters, or Supreme Court stamps received
Bank RTGS/NEFT debit counterfoils, UTR numbers, and beneficiary account details
Incoming call records and timestamps

investigation_hints.preliminary_action: Extremely high value cases: immediately alert I4C nodal officers and destination bank nodal for RTGS recall
notices_required: Urgent Sec 91 BNSS to Beneficiary Bank for RTGS/NEFT branch tracing
Notice to Skype/Microsoft for IP logs and device identifiers
Look-Out Circular (LOC) advisory if international routing identified
investigation_hints.mule_pattern: High-value funds routed via newly opened Shell Company Current Accounts, split into multiple RTGS legs within 60 minutes

patterns.name: Fake Stock Trading App & Crypto Investment Scam
attack_chain: Victim is added to an exclusive WhatsApp or Telegram group advertising high-return institutional stock tips
Scammers pose as reputed SEBI-registered fund managers or international wealth advisors
Victim is guided to download an unlisted trading app or trade via a customized web terminal
Dashboard displays fictitious 200%-500% profits on mock IPO or stock allocations
When victim requests fund withdrawal, account is locked and demands 20-30% 'SEBI verification tax' or 'capital gains fees'

immediate_actions: Do NOT pay any 'tax', 'margin money', or 'clearing fee' to withdraw — these are fake demands
Verify the broker on the official SEBI website (sebi.gov.in) — legitimate brokers never ask money in individual accounts
Call 1930 immediately with full list of transfers and UTR numbers
Download complete WhatsApp/Telegram chat history before administrators delete messages
evidence_to_preserve: Screenshots of trading dashboard showing fictitious balance and deposit ledger
All bank statements showing RTGS/NEFT/UPI transfers with UTRs
APK file of the fake app or URL of the trading web terminal
Admin phone numbers and chat export of the investment group

investigation_hints.preliminary_action: Freeze destination accounts across primary recipient banks via I4C portal; flag rogue domain to CERT-In
notices_required: Section 91 BNSS to Beneficiary Banks for full KYC and debit freeze
Notice to Web Host / Cloudflare / Domain Registrar for subscriber details
Notice to WhatsApp/Telegram for group creator telemetry
investigation_hints.mule_pattern: Funds deposited into diverse current accounts across multiple states, converted to USDT through OTC crypto desks

patterns.name: Sextortion & WhatsApp Video Call Trap
attack_chain: Victim receives an unsolicited WhatsApp video call from unknown number showing an explicit female
Call lasts a few seconds during which victim's face is recorded alongside explicit footage
Minutes later, victim receives morphed video clips showing victim's face on obscene video
Scammer threatens to upload video to YouTube and send to victim's Facebook friends and relatives
Followed by call from fake 'Delhi Police / Crime Branch officer' or 'YouTube Manager' demanding fee to delete clip

immediate_actions: Do NOT pay any money — paying never stops extortion, they will ask for more
Lock and privatize your Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn accounts immediately
Block the caller numbers on WhatsApp; do not engage in further conversation
Call 1930 or local cyber police station immediately
Take emotional support from family; cyber police deal with hundreds of identical cases daily
evidence_to_preserve: Screenshots of the extortion messages, threats, and demanded amounts
Phone numbers from which calls and messages originated
UPI ID where money was demanded or transferred
Call log showing incoming video call duration

investigation_hints.preliminary_action: Identify geo-location cluster (frequently Mewat / Bharatpur / Alwar region); freeze extortion recipient UPI VPAs
notices_required: Section 91 BNSS to UPI PSP for beneficiary details
Section 91 BNSS to Telecom for CAF and CDR of extortionist SIMs (often pre-activated fake SIMs)
investigation_hints.mule_pattern: Immediate transfer to local merchant QR codes or AePS cash-out points in border districts

patterns.name: Fake KYC Expiry & Bank Account Block Threat Scam
patterns.primary_ncrp_subcategory: Debit/Credit Card Fraud / SIM Swap Fraud
attack_chain: Victim receives SMS claiming bank account or debit card will be blocked within 24 hours due to pending KYC/PAN
SMS contains short phishing link or link to download a malicious APK (e.g. 'SBI_KYC_Update.apk')
Victim enters Internet Banking username, password, date of birth, and OTP on the fake website/APK
Malicious APK intercepts all incoming SMS OTPs and forwards them to the scammer's server
Scammer adds new beneficiary or initiates instant IMPS/UPI transfers draining victim's account

immediate_actions: Banks NEVER send SMS links to update KYC or PAN — legitimate KYC is done in-branch or via official banking app
Call your bank's emergency helpline immediately to block netbanking and debit cards
Call 1930 with your transaction UTR numbers
Uninstall any downloaded KYC app and perform a factory reset if OTPs are still being intercepted
evidence_to_preserve: Original SMS with SMS header (e.g., 'VM-SBINB', 'AX-HDFCBK')
URL of the phishing website from browser history
Bank statement showing unauthorized debit and beneficiary account
Downloaded APK file if available

investigation_hints.preliminary_action: Report SMS header to Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) and DoT Chakshu portal; freeze beneficiary bank accounts
notices_required: Section 91 BNSS to Beneficiary Bank for IMPS tracing
Notice to Phishing Hosting Provider / Registrar for immediate domain takedown
Notice to SMS Aggregator for sender header tracing
investigation_hints.mule_pattern: Funds transferred via IMPS into mule savings accounts, subsequently withdrawn via AePS or POS terminals

patterns.name: Customs Parcel & Courier Clearance Fraud
attack_chain: Victim is informed that an overseas parcel, courier, or gift is addressed to them and held at airport customs
Scammer posing as customs/FedEx official claims parcel contains illegal contraband, jewelry, or cash
Victim is told they face arrest unless they pay clearance charges, GST, or 'Anti-Terrorism Clearance Fee'
Victim transfers fees into specified bank accounts; scammer keeps inventing new clearance fees until victim runs out of money

immediate_actions: Indian Customs NEVER requests duty payment into individual personal bank accounts
Do NOT pay any additional clearance fees
Call 1930 immediately to register the transaction references
Verify any international tracking number directly on the official courier website (fedex.com, dhl.com)
evidence_to_preserve: Screenshots of emails/WhatsApp messages claiming customs detention
Copies of fake receipts, customs certificates, or invoices received
Bank payment slips showing beneficiary details and UTRs
Phone numbers and call history
helpline_contacts: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC) Helpline

investigation_hints.preliminary_action: Issue freeze mandate to recipient bank accounts via I4C CFCFRMS portal
notices_required: Section 91 BNSS to Beneficiary Bank for KYC and withdrawal trail
Section 91 BNSS to Telecom Provider for CDR of caller numbers
investigation_hints.mule_pattern: Funds moved through multiple intermediary accounts, often withdrawn in African/Southeast Asian syndicate nexus

patterns.name: Remote Access & Screen Sharing Tech Support Scam
attack_chain: Victim searches Google for customer care (Swiggy, Zomato, bank, courier) and dials a fraudulent number listed on SEO-poisoned search results
Scammer asks victim to install a screen-sharing tool (AnyDesk, TeamViewer, RustDesk) to 'resolve the refund'
Victim reads out the 9-digit remote access address and grants screen sharing permissions
Scammer instructs victim to open their banking or UPI app and enter login credentials
Scammer views credentials and OTP in real-time or blacks out victim's screen while initiating transfers

immediate_actions: Uninstall the remote access app (AnyDesk/TeamViewer/RustDesk) IMMEDIATELY
Put phone on Airplane mode to sever active sessions
Call 1930 immediately to freeze fraudulent transfers
Contact your bank to lock netbanking credentials and card services
evidence_to_preserve: The phone number dialed from Google search
App session logs or screenshot of the AnyDesk 9-digit code session
Bank debit alert SMS and transaction references (UTRs)
Google search term and history screenshot

investigation_hints.preliminary_action: Emergency lien placement on beneficiary accounts; report fraudulent customer care phone numbers to DoT Chakshu portal
notices_required: Section 91 BNSS to Beneficiary Bank for transaction reversal
Notice to AnyDesk / TeamViewer for connection session metadata and remote IP address
Notice to Google for removing SEO-poisoned customer care numbers
investigation_hints.mule_pattern: Immediate transfer to wallet/UPI and cash-out via POS agents within 30 minutes

patterns.name: AePS Biometric Clone & Micro-ATM Fraud
attack_chain: Scammers harvest biometric fingerprints and Aadhaar numbers from public land registry documents or compromised CSP databases
Cloned fingerprints are fabricated on silicon, rubber, or polymer sheets
Fraudsters visit remote banking correspondents (Customer Service Points / CSPs) or rogue Micro-ATMs
Using cloned biometric impressions and victim's Aadhaar number, unauthorized daily AePS withdrawals (₹10,000 limits) are executed without OTP

immediate_actions: LOCK your Aadhaar Biometrics immediately using mAadhaar App or UIDAI portal (resident.uidai.gov.in)
Call 1930 and report unauthorized AePS withdrawal
Visit your home bank branch and submit a written dispute for unauthorized AePS debit under NPCI guidelines
File an official police complaint to obtain compensation under RBI circular on unauthorized electronic banking transactions
evidence_to_preserve: Bank passbook / statement entry showing AePS transaction, CSP code, and RRN number
SMS alerts received from bank regarding cash withdrawal
Proof of Aadhaar biometric lock confirmation

investigation_hints.preliminary_action: Identify acquiring bank and Banking Correspondent (BC) network via NPCI to pinpoint the exact Micro-ATM terminal and CSP operator
notices_required: Section 91 BNSS to NPCI / Acquiring Bank for BC/CSP name, physical location, and terminal ID
Physical inspection and CCTV footage seizure at CSP kiosk premises
investigation_hints.mule_pattern: Local CSP agents colluding with fraudsters or compromised rural POS terminals

patterns.name: Social Media Account Hijack & Fake Profile Impersonation
attack_chain: Perpetrator either hacks victim's account via phishing or downloads photos to create a clone account with an identical username
Perpetrator messages all followers/friends claiming urgent financial emergency (e.g. 'Hospital admission, need ₹10,000 urgently')
Friends transfer funds to perpetrator's UPI address believing they are aiding the victim
Victim only discovers the incident when friends call inquiring about the emergency

immediate_actions: Post a broadcast alert on other social media channels / WhatsApp status that your account is cloned/hacked
Report the profile directly within the app (Report -> Pretending to be someone I know)
If original account was hacked, use platform account recovery (instagram.com/hacked)
Advise friends who transferred money to immediately call 1930 with the UPI UTR
evidence_to_preserve: Exact URL / handle of the fake profile
Screenshots of chats where the impersonator requested money with UPI details
List of friends who transferred money and their transaction UTR numbers

investigation_hints.preliminary_action: Serve preservation notice to Meta / platform for IP logs, registration email, and mobile number
notices_required: Notice under IT Act 79(3)(b) / BNSS to Meta Platforms Inc for account removal and registration IPs
Section 91 BNSS to UPI PSP for beneficiary account details
investigation_hints.mule_pattern: Personal UPI accounts or mule wallets quickly cashed out via food delivery or merchant QR purchases

patterns.name: E-Commerce, Fake Shopping Store & Lucky Draw Lottery Scam
attack_chain: Victim clicks sponsored ad on Instagram/Facebook offering luxury items (iPhones, branded shoes) at 80-90% discounts
Fake e-commerce website accepts prepaid UPI/Card payment, provides a fictitious tracking number, but never ships goods
Or: Victim receives letter/call claiming they won ₹25 Lakh in KBC lottery or a car in lucky draw
Victim is induced to pay successive 'processing fees', 'tax clearances', and 'delivery insurance' before realizing no prize exists

immediate_actions: Discontinue all communications and do NOT pay any 'tax' or 'deposit fee' for gifts
Call 1930 with transaction UTR numbers
Contact your bank or card issuer to initiate a chargeback for 'merchandise not received'
Report the scam advertisement to the hosting platform
evidence_to_preserve: Website URL and receipt of purchase / order confirmation email
Ad screenshot and payment transaction reference (UTR)
Any letters or documents received regarding lottery winnings

investigation_hints.preliminary_action: Identify payment gateway (Razorpay/Cashfree/PayU) used on the fake store and order immediate account freeze
notices_required: Section 91 BNSS to Payment Gateway for merchant KYC, bank account, and settlement logs
Takedown notice to Domain Registrar / Cloudflare for scam website
investigation_hints.mule_pattern: Payment gateway settlements withdrawn into mule current accounts

patterns.name: Online Matrimonial & Romance Scam
attack_chain: Scammer creates an attractive profile on Shaadi.com / Jeevansathi claiming to be an affluent NRI doctor/engineer
Scammer builds intense emotional intimacy with victim over several weeks via WhatsApp calls and messages
Scammer announces travel to India for marriage or states they sent an expensive parcel with jewelry and currency
Victim receives call from fake customs/immigration claiming fiance was detained or parcel requires heavy tax clearance
Emotionally committed victim transfers life savings across multiple accounts to 'clear' their prospective spouse

immediate_actions: Never send money to someone you have only met online, regardless of their marriage promises
Stop all payments immediately; do not believe claims that the person is detained at customs
Call 1930 Cyber Helpline with all payment UTRs
Report the profile directly to the matrimonial website trust and safety team
evidence_to_preserve: Full chat export from WhatsApp and profile screenshots from matrimonial site
Bank statements showing all transfers with UTRs and account details
Photographs, flight tickets, or passport copies sent by the suspect

investigation_hints.preliminary_action: Lien beneficiary accounts via 1930 / CFCFRMS; serve preservation notice to matrimonial platform
notices_required: Section 91 BNSS to Matrimonial Platform for profile IP history, verified phone, and photo metadata
Section 91 BNSS to Beneficiary Banks for full KYC and money trail
investigation_hints.mule_pattern: Multi-state African and local syndicate network operating through layered mule savings accounts
